purpose: Test whether a small per-candidate residual scorer improves teacher-elite ranking on full 300-candidate banks from student-driven PushT planner contexts.

scope.training: train the residual MLP only; freeze the h256 recurrent student
scope.validation: score baseline-generated full candidate banks; do not deploy treatment in CEM

base_student.claim: Reuse the exact seeded-pilot student checkpoint; no fresh checkpoint reconstruction claim.

provenance.preprocessing_boundary: Episode/task-level isolation only. The official dataset-wide scaler reads train columns that include reserved validation task rows; this is not row-level preprocessing isolation.
provenance.pilot_artifact_limit: 25537667 exports costs and summaries but not candidate action tensors or encoded contexts; it is evidence only and is not a training source.

validation.use_rule: Use only after training is complete for the frozen predictor-level gate; do not train, select checkpoints, tune thresholds, or replace episodes from these tasks.

untouched.use_rule: Do not evaluate, score, inspect per-task outputs, or use for a decision in this experiment.

collection.policy: Frozen base student generates every candidate bank and all real actions; the residual MLP is absent during collection.

reset.rng_rule: Seed once per episode; keep the native solver RNG continuation from t0 to t25; never reseed between solves.

environment_protocol.dataset_mode: Pinned World.evaluate dataset mode, one frozen episode per World instance, num_envs=1

cem.capture_rule: At each reached t0/t25 replan and each captured CEM round, persist the entire 300-candidate bank in native index order.

bank_record.alignment_rule: Context, action sequence, teacher cost, and student cost must retain the same task/round/candidate index. Preserve full banks; do not truncate, screen, reorder, or K-select candidates before writing.
bank_record.cost_validity: All costs and actions finite. A non-finite cost or a zero/invalid population standard deviation invalidates the run; do not silently clamp or drop that bank.
bank_record.storage: Keep full banks on the compute node; return only compact summaries, gate records, job log, status, terminal state, and GPU telemetry.

first_four_task_noninterference_gate.comparison: For each task, pair capture/shadow recording enabled and disabled runs from identical frozen reset and solver RNG states.
required_exact_matches: solver RNG before and after every solve
first_four_task_noninterference_gate.pass_rule: All four task pairs pass every required comparison before the remaining collection, fitting, or validation proceeds. On any mismatch, mark invalid and stop; do not substitute tasks. Retain the recording-enabled banks only after the paired gate passes.

ranker.control: Frozen base h256 student; rank candidates by bank-z-normalized student objective cost.

treatment.trainable_component: Per-candidate residual MLP only; no cross-candidate attention or student parameter updates.
treatment.initialization: Initialize the final linear weight and bias to zero so the initial corrected score equals the frozen control score.
treatment.bank_normalization: For each 300-candidate bank, z-score student cost with that bank's population mean and standard deviation. Require finite standard deviation > 1e-6; otherwise invalidate the run.

loss.teacher_target: Use the official ascending torch.argsort semantics on teacher objective; its first 30 candidate indices define a uniform target distribution over all 300 candidates.
loss.student_distribution: softmax(-corrected_score / 0.5) over all 300 candidates in that bank.
loss.listwise_cross_entropy: Mean cross-entropy from the uniform teacher top-30 target to the student distribution, averaged per bank.
loss.residual_penalty: 1e-3 * mean(residual^2) over all candidates in the update batch.

optimization.sampling: Uniform bank sampling with replacement from training banks using the frozen training seed; use all 300 candidates for each sampled bank.

validation.unit: source episode; banks and CEM rounds within an episode are repeated measures, not independent samples
validation.banks: Baseline-generated validation banks at t0/t25 and rounds 10/20/30. Apply the frozen residual MLP post hoc to the same full banks used by control; never feed treatment scores back into CEM.
validation.primary_metric: For each bank, standardized teacher-elite regret = (mean teacher cost of candidates selected by the scorer's top30 - mean teacher cost of the teacher's top30) / population_std(teacher_cost_300). Lower is better.
validation.aggregation: For each episode, take the median treatment-minus-control regret across its available paired t0/t25 banks and rounds. Then compute the median across episode medians. For each CEM round, first take each episode's median across available t0/t25 banks, then the median across episodes.

gates.finite_and_paired: All scored banks finite and every treatment/control comparison uses the same task, state, candidate actions, and candidate indices.
gates.minimum_t25_coverage: At least 6 of 8 validation episodes must reach a t25 replan after exactly 25 committed transitions. Do not replace episodes; if coverage is lower, mark inconclusive/NO-GO.
gates.decision: GO only if every validity, coverage, primary, episode-count, and per-round gate passes; otherwise NO-GO or inconclusive as specified above.

resources.allocation: One PBS compute-node job with one GPU
runner_guards: require an allocated compute node and reject login-node execution
resources.banked_reset_credits: Do not query, consume, or otherwise use.

claim_boundary: A passing result supports only predictor-level candidate ranking on baseline-generated, student-driven full CEM banks from these task-level held-out episodes. It does not establish treatment CEM behavior, planner deployment, closed-loop success, predictor speedup, or generalization beyond this split.
